What each campaign, ad group or ad spent and got: the platform's clicks next to the signups, payers
and revenue Voidhash measured, with an estimate of what the clicks it could not see may have earned.

The period is the last 7 complete days unless --last or --from says otherwise. Rows sort by spend,
highest first; name and cost-per-payer sort lowest first.

Usage:
  voidhash ads report performance [flags]

Flags:
      --breakdown <placement|surface|country|age|gender|device>
                                      Also split each row by this
      --campaign <campaign>           Only this campaign (its name or id), or the ad groups and ads
                                      in it; repeat for each (can be repeated)
      --currency <code>               ISO 4217 code money is reported in (default: the ad accounts'
                                      currency)
      --delivery <active|needs-attention>
                                      Only delivering or learning rows, or those that need attention
      --environment <production|sandbox|test>
                                      Purchases revenue is read from: production, sandbox (App Store
                                      and Google Play sandbox) or test (debug builds' simulated
                                      purchases and test modes such as Stripe's) (default:
                                      production)
      --from <day>                    First day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of --last)
  -h, --help                          Show help for this command
      --json                          Print the API report as JSON, for scripts
      --last <span>                   The complete days before today to report on: a span such as
                                      7d, 4w, 3m or 1y (default: 7d)
      --level <campaign|ad-group|ad>  One row per campaign, ad group or ad (default: campaign)
      --limit <limit>                 Rows to show (default: 50, at most 200)
      --project <project>             Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name
                                      (default: this directory's project, then your default project)
      --sort <spend|name|impressions|link-clicks|ctr|platform-roas|signups|payers|cost-per-payer|net-revenue|roas>
                                      What rows are sorted by (default: spend)
      --timezone <zone>               IANA time zone days are cut in (default: the ad accounts' time
                                      zone)
      --to <day>                      Last day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today; with
                                      --from)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash ads report performance
  voidhash ads report performance --level ad --campaign "Spring sale" --sort roas
  voidhash ads report performance --last 30d --breakdown country --json
